title: Observability: try_module_get failure in lookup_algo indistinguishable from no provider registered
description: crypto2dev_lookup_algo returns NULL both when no provider is registered for an algo and when try_module_get() fails (provider module being removed). Both cases surface in ioctl_init as -ENOENT with the message 'no provider registered for this algo'. A support engineer cannot distinguish a mis-loaded provider from a racing module unload. The fix is a distinct log path in lookup_algo or the ioctl when module_get fails, but the current code merges the two into one indistinguishable message.
